_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. config.json is gitignored: it holds your identity and your candid notes about companies.
_exclude_note: Exclude on domain and level, never on job family. Excluding 'technical program manager' wholesale once blocked every monetization TPM role, which was squarely on target.
_location_note: A posting matching 'local' or 'remote' passes. An ambiguous national posting passes with a flag, because under-filtering beats hiding a reachable role. A named city elsewhere is concrete, not ambiguous.
_comp_note: Only a PARSED maximum below this disqualifies. Most postings list no range, and absence must never filter.

Example Corp.history: Free text injected into the fit prompt. Your real history with this company: loops run, outcomes, anything that should temper a score.
Example Corp.rule: Plain-language rule the model should apply, e.g. only surface senior IC roles that are remote or local.

_policy_note: dormant_days overrides the default per company. Set it to whatever review window the employer actually states; a fixed 21 marked a live referred application dead.
_identity_note: Used to drop your own replies from the event stream. Without it your own sent mail becomes a company.
_watchlist_note: Public board APIs only: greenhouse, ashby, lever. The slug is the company's handle in that board's URL.
